meta.name: task-coordination-strategies
meta.description: Decompose complex tasks, design dependency graphs, and coordinate multi-agent work with proper task descriptions and workload balancing. Use this skill when breaking down work for agent teams, managing task dependencies, or monitoring team progress.

copy.tagline: 拆解复杂任务，协调多个代理高效执行

copy.tagline_en: Break down complex tasks and coordinate multiple agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to lead multiple AI agents to finish complex tasks together

howto.what: Claude 会把复杂任务拆成可并行的子任务,设计依赖图(blockedBy/blocks),为每个任务写明目标、所属文件与验收标准,并监控团队负载、重新分配积压任务。
howto.when: 当你要把复杂工作分派给多个 agent、设计任务依赖关系,或跟踪团队进度时触发。

say.text: 把这个全栈功能拆成能并行开发的子任务,标出依赖关系
say.note: 给出拆分方案和依赖图

say.text: 给这些任务写清目标、所属文件和验收标准
看看谁负载过重,把待办任务重新分配一下
say.note: 给出再平衡步骤和通知

howto.what_en: Claude breaks complex tasks into parallelizable units, designs dependency graphs (blockedBy/blocks), writes task descriptions with objectives, owned files and acceptance criteria, and monitors workload to reassign tasks.
howto.when_en: Use when splitting work across agent teams, designing task dependencies, or monitoring team progress.

say_en.text: Break this full-stack feature into parallel subtasks and map the dependencies
say_en.note: Returns a split plan and dependency graph

say_en.text: Write objectives, owned files, and acceptance criteria for these tasks
say_en.note: Generates task descriptions from the template

say_en.text: Check who is overloaded and reassign the pending tasks
